description: This Swift source file defines the SoundEffectCatalog and SoundEffectPlayer enums, which manage system sound effects. The catalog lists available sound names, searches specific directories for sound files, and maps sound names to URLs. The player provides methods to retrieve NSSound objects by name or bookmark data and to play sounds.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of all discoverable system sound names, with 'Glass' pinned first, sorted case-insensitively.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns the display name for a given sound raw name, currently a direct mapping.

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the URL associated with a sound name from the discovered sound map.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Returns an NSSound object for the given sound name, either from system resources or custom URLs.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound from bookmark data, accessing the security scoped resource.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Plays the provided NSSound object using the last played sound reference.
